analysis.headline: Shares Your Data Online
analysis.quote: When we detect a GPC signal from a reader’s browser where GDPR, CCPA or a similar privacy law applies, we stop sharing the reader’s personal data online with other companies (except with our service providers).

analysis.headline: Third Parties Collect Your Data
analysis.quote: Third-party advertisers collect behavioral data associated with their ads shown on our site or apps.

analysis.headline: Collects Data from Social Media
analysis.quote: Additionally, we collect data about readers from sources like privately owned databases and social media platforms.

analysis.headline: Tracks Your Reading Behavior
analysis.quote: Our tracking technologies collect data about your reading behavior, like which articles you read, which recipes you save, which Games you play or how often you visit The Times.

analysis.headline: Your Data Used for Ads
analysis.quote: Our advertisers ask us to use reader data so their ads can be targeted at the right audiences.

analysis.headline: Social Logins Share Your Data
analysis.quote: If you sign up via Facebook or Google, they share limited data with us so we can create an account for you.
